source: Next 16.4.6 package installed from the route lock with Node 24.22.3

commands.output:
Usage: next build [directory] [options]

Creates an optimized production build of your application. The output displays
information about each route.

Arguments:
  [directory]                              A directory on which to build the application. If no directory is provided, the current directory will be used.

Options:
  --analyze                                Analyze bundle output. Only compatible with Turbopack.
  -d, --debug                              Enables a more verbose build output.
  --debug-prerender                        Enables debug mode for prerendering. Not for production use!
  --no-mangling                            Disables mangling.
  --profile                                Enables production profiling for React.
  --experimental-app-only                  Builds only App Router routes.
  --turbo                                  Builds using Turbopack.
  --turbopack                              Builds using Turbopack.
  --webpack                                Builds using webpack.
  --experimental-build-mode [mode]         Uses an experimental build mode. (choices: "compile", "generate", "generate-env", default: "default")
  --experimental-debug-memory-usage        Enables memory profiling features to debug memory consumption.
  --experimental-upload-trace, <traceUrl>  Reports a subset of the debugging trace to a remote HTTP URL. Includes sensitive data.
  --experimental-next-config-strip-types   Use Node.js native TypeScript resolution for next.config.(ts|mts)
  --debug-build-paths <patterns>           Comma-separated glob patterns or explicit paths for selective builds. Use "!" prefix to exclude. Examples: "app/*", "app/page.tsx", "app/**/page.tsx", "app/**,!app/[slug]/**"
  --experimental-cpu-prof                  Enable CPU profiling. Profile is saved to .next-profiles/ on exit.
  --internal-trace [level]                 Enable Turbopack tracing. "all" (default) enables turbo-tasks level tracing, "overview" enables overview tracing. (choices: "all", "overview", preset: "all")
  -h, --help                               Displays this message.

Usage: next analyze|experimental-analyze [options] [command] [directory]

Analyze production bundle output with an interactive web ui. Does not produce
an application build. Only compatible with Turbopack.

Arguments:
  [directory]                   A directory on which to analyze the
                                application. If no directory is provided, the
                                current directory will be used.

Options:
  -v, --version                 Outputs the Next.js version.
  --no-mangling                 Disables mangling.
  --profile                     Enables production profiling for React.
  --experimental-app-only       Analyzes only App Router routes.
  --snapshot <name>             Save a named snapshot, replacing an existing
                                capture with that name.
  -o, --output                  Only write analysis files to disk. Does not
                                start the server.
  --port <port>                 Specify a port number to serve the analyzer on.
                                (default: 4000, env: PORT)
  -h, --help                    Displays this message.

Commands:
  export [options] [directory]  Stream a saved analyzer graph as JSON Lines
                                without building or serving.
